2v2 Arena is a competitive mode where wanderers can match singly or in pairs. In this mode, teammates cannot be revived, and healing effects are reduced by 70%. After a period in combat, damage dealt increases while healing becomes less effective.

 Using Deflect consumes Endurance, while finishing Execute restores Endurance. Most player skills can be deflected. Defense-breaking Mystic Skills not only ignore deflect but also deal enhanced effects when hitting targets who are defending or deflecting. However, these Mystic Skills can be interrupted by any skill. Player skills, including Mystic Skills and Charged Skill, can interrupt Light and Heavy Attacks, but not vice versa. Effective use of control-breaking Skills can turn the tide. In 2v2 Arena, defeating opponents grants 2v2 Arena points. Those with the highest points will be ranked on the Leaderboard.

 Mobile and PC players are matched separately. If abnormal activity is detected on a cross-platform account, that player will be queued on the PC platform in future matchmaking. The side that defeats all opponents first within the time limit wins. If the timer runs out without a decisive outcome, the winner is determined by the following priorities: 1. The side with more surviving players wins; 2. If the number of surviving players is equal, the side with the higher total damage dealt wins; 3. If the total damage dealt is equal, the side with the higher total healing amount wins.
